description: This file contains implementation for range-related tensor creation functions optimized for Apple MPS backend, including 'arange_mps', 'range_mps', and 'linspace_out_mps', utilizing MPSGraph for GPU acceleration.

classes.name: RangeCachedGraph
classes.description: A cached graph object for range operations on MPS, holding references to graph tensors and managing the creation and reuse of computation graphs for efficient execution.

methods.name: arange_mps_out
methods.description: Creates a range tensor on MPS GPU with specified start, end, and step, writing the result into the provided tensor.

methods.name: range_mps_out
methods.description: Generates a tensor with values from start to end with specified step on MPS GPU, storing in provided tensor.

methods.name: linspace_out_mps
methods.description: Fills the provided tensor with linearly spaced values between start and end over a specified number of steps, optimized for MPS.
